---
title: "Workshop"
description: "An interdisciplinary workshop for scientists, philosophers and STS scholars on error in AI-driven modeling."
---

A two-day interdisciplinary workshop where scientists, philosophers and STS
scholars work through real cases of error in AI-driven modeling, and where the
project's developing framework is presented for feedback. The program will mix
invited talks, discussion sessions and working groups.

We especially welcome early-career researchers, including graduate students,
as participants and presenters, and researchers from sciences beyond climate.

**When:** at the end of the project's first year; date to be announced.

**Venue:** to be announced.

## Call for extended abstracts and speakers

The call for extended abstracts and invitations to speakers will go out in
**February 2027**. Topics, deadlines and submission instructions will be posted
here. To hear when the call opens, [get in touch](contact.qmd).

## Travel and registration

Details on registration and the venue will be posted with the call. We plan
to offer support for PhD students and early-career researchers to attend and
present.

## Venue accessibility

Information on step-free access, captioning and other accommodations will be
posted here. If you have an access need, please [contact us](contact.qmd).

## Code of conduct

The workshop will have a code of conduct, posted here before registration
opens.

## Program

The program will be posted once speakers are confirmed.

## Presentation files

Accepted presenters will receive instructions for uploading slides. Recordings
and slides are published on the [Deliverables](deliverables.qmd) page only with
each presenter's permission.
